attributes.name: Jordimandus
attributes.powers:
Before you encounter Jordimandus, summon and encounter a random monster. If you defeat that monster, you may discard a weapon or a spell with the Attack trait to attempt a Diplomacy 14 check to defeat Jordimandus. If you fail, Jordimandus is undefeated, and deals Mental damage that may not be reduced.

If undefeated, a random character at this location takes 1d4+1 Acid damage.
